kai_pm: Quick sync : proposing a conservative rollout for `smart-fallback-v2`. We need a rollout ladder, explicit rollback ladder, customer opt-out, and a short communications script.
hannah_eng: SGTM. What's the ladder idea?
kai_pm: Shadow -> micro (0.1%) -> canary-region (2%) -> pilot tenants (3 tenants, 24h each) -> global warm (20%) -> global. Manual gate after pilots.
omar_sre: Add concrete aborts: 5xx spike >0.3% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency +60ms for 10m OR error budget burn > 50% in 1h -> immediate rollback. Also track infra saturation (gpu/cpu) >85% for 8m.
lucy_platform: Flag model: `smart-fallback-v2` with attrs: `stage`, `pct`, `region_allowlist`, `tenant_exempt`, `auto_advance` (bool), `force_off_api`. I'll wire webhook hooks for aborts and a one-click kill switch.
hannah_eng: For safety bias, within active pct we'll do 80/20 control/candidate. Evaluation: collect 5k requests per stage and run the quick eval job.
kai_pm: Quality pass: no eval regression >0.8%, user error delta <=0.25%, cost delta <5%. PM + Eng + SRE signoff required at pilot-evidence before warm.
omar_sre: Also require no queue growth >12% for 10m. Add cache-affinity probe: if cache_miss_delta >10% for 20m, pause.
lucy_platform: Config snippet we'll include in runbook: ```yaml
flag: smart-fallback-v2
stages:
  - name: shadow
    mode: shadow
    duration_min: 120
  - name: micro
    pct: 0.1
    regions: [us-west-2]
    duration_min: 30
  - name: canary-region
    pct: 2
    regions: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
    duration_min: 45
  - name: pilots
    pilot_tenants: [acct-442, acct-812, acct-129]
    duration_h: 24
  - name: warm
    pct: 20
    regions: [global]
    duration_min: 60
manual_gate_after: pilots
abort_conditions:
  - expr: "5xx_rate > 0.3% for 5m"
  - expr: "p99_latency_delta_ms > 60 for 10m"
  - expr: "error_budget_burn_pct > 50 for 60m"
  - expr: "cache_miss_delta_pct > 10 for 20m"
tenant_exempt: [enterprise/*]
force_off_api: /api/flags/smart-fallback-v2
```
hannah_eng: I want an explicit "rollback ladder" that defines staged rollback steps (soft-roll: reduce pct to 0 and keep shadow; hard-roll: full revert + incident).
kai_pm: Good call. Add steps and comm text: soft-roll first if transient; escalate to hard-roll if abort persists >15m or multiple abort triggers.
omar_sre: Escalation play: soft-roll -> create incident ticket -> triage channel opens -> if unresolved in 30m or second abort -> hard-roll + notify customers. CS notified if >2 tenants impacted.
lucy_platform: We'll add per-tenant opt-out and a per-tenant `last_seen_divergence` metric so we can pause selective tenants without impacting others.
hannah_eng: Tests: unit + integration + 3h shadow synthetic run logging to `index=smart-fallback-shadow`. Also run a divergence checker that compares N=10k golden samples nightly.
kai_pm: Customer messaging snippets: pre-pilot: "We're piloting a routing improvement with a small set of tenants. You may be contacted to opt-in." If rollback: "We've reverted routing to ensure stability; investigating. Reach out to support if you see issues."
omar_sre: Alerts: pager if abort triggers hit; otherwise slack notify to #sre-ops. Also pager if two different aborts hit within 15m.
lucy_platform: Adding a `tenant_opt_out_reason` field to the audit logs and an RBAC-protected support endpoint to force-legacy a tenant.
hannah_eng: Edge-case: sticky sessions and KV-cache affinity. Add a sticky-drop probe (threshold 0.8%) and a cache-warm path that primes top-200 keys during shadow.
kai_pm: Decision: run shadow tonight 23:00 UTC for 3h. Micro tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Canary-region same day 16:00 UTC. Pilot tenants start Wednesday 09:00 UTC. Warm on Thursday. Global after manual gate. Owners: kai_pm (PM), hannah_eng (eng lead), omar_sre (oncall), lucy_platform (flags). PM signoff required at pilots.
lucy_platform: Draft flag created: smart-fallback-v2 by lucy_platform. Webhook: /hooks/flag-events wired. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/smart-fallback (request perms).
omnibot: Reminder set: 1932469800 -> shadow start.
kai_pm: I'll post a short note to #customer-success at pilot gate and ping enterprise owners for tenant-exempts.
hannah_eng: I'll kick off the shadow prep in 30m and post logs.
omar_sre: I'll prep oncall rota and the rollback shortcut.
lucy_platform: I'll seed `tenant_exempt` for enterprise labels and create per-tenant force-off RBAC roles.
kai_pm: Thanks everyone. Closing thread unless issues. :white_check_mark:
